name: Point-based Neural Light Field
definition: A neural light field representation that avoids the 3D geometry-agnostic nature of direct ray-to-color mapping by sampling points along the ray and predicting density and color for each point, then accumulating them via volume rendering.
summary: Point-based Neural Light Field predicts density and color for all sample points in a single pass for efficient batch rendering, differing from standard NeRF by avoiding 3D geometry-agnostic direct ray-to-color mapping.
